title: Non-bulging Fatou components for transcendental skew-products
summary: In this paper, we investigate the bulging of escaping or oscillating Fatou components on invariant fibers for general skew-products, with a focus on the dependence on the perturbation. We show that any orbitally unbounded component is non-bulging for an appropriate choice of perturbation, whereas sufficiently well-behaved perturbations can render it bulging when the fiber is attracting.
